edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares, payable in immediately available funds at Closing, without set-off, deduction or withholding except as required by applicable law.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 30 days after signing, or on such other date as the Seller and Buyer may agree in writing, and in any event subject to the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions precedent applicable to the Seller.

3. Representations. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate in all material respects and fairly present the financial condition and results of operations of the Company as of the dates and for the periods stated therein, subject to the qualifications and exceptions set forth in this Agreement and the disclosure schedules.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, and each party shall keep them confidential except as required by law, regulation, or to its representatives, financing sources, and professional advisers subject to customary confidentiality obligations.

receiver.requested_changes: Buyer’s initial comments: (1) Reduce the purchase price materially from USD 45,000,000; price should be subject to further diligence and adjustment. (2) Permit customary closing deliverables and conditions precedent for the Buyer as well as the Seller, and extend the outside date beyond 30 days. (3) Broaden the Seller’s reps with explicit knowledge/materiality qualifiers removed where possible, a bring-down at closing, and specific fundamental reps (title, capacity, authority, no undisclosed liabilities, compliance, taxes, litigation, IP, employees, and solvency). (4) Add indemnity and survival provisions, including escrows/holdbacks, and reverse the blanket no set-off language so the Buyer can withhold for claims or required adjustments. (5) Tighten confidentiality so disclosures to financing sources and advisers are only on a need-to-know basis and subject to enforceable obligations.
receiver.message_back: Thank you for the draft. We have reviewed it and will return a markup focused on economics, closing conditions, and a fuller seller protection package. At a high level, the Buyer cannot accept the headline price or the current no-set-off payment structure, and we will propose a more balanced closing timetable and stronger seller reps and remedies. We look forward to exchanging comments.

I made only modest, market-facing refinements to closing and confidentiality so the draft appears balanced while preserving the Seller’s position.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your note. We have incorporated a few drafting refinements to keep the agreement balanced and moving, but we have not revised the Seller’s economics or agreed to an open-ended price adjustment, escrow/holdback, or expanded indemnity regime. The current draft is intended to reflect the agreed commercial framework, with customary closing mechanics and confidentiality protections. We are happy to discuss any targeted points that are important to your client, but our view is that the draft is now in a workable place for further comment.

receiver.requested_changes: Please revise the draft to address the Buyer’s core protections on a targeted basis: (1) a clear completion accounts / net debt-working capital adjustment or, at minimum, a limited escrow/holdback for any leakage identified at closing; (2) Buyer-side closing conditions, including delivery of all closing deliverables and a bring-down of the Seller’s reps at Closing; (3) a more workable indemnity package with survival periods, baskets/caps, and express carve-outs for fundamental reps, taxes, title, and fraud; and (4) confirmation that the confidentiality clause permits disclosures to the Buyer’s affiliates, insurers, auditors, and regulators as needed. We are not looking to reopen the whole commercial framework, but these points are important to our client.
receiver.message_back:
Thank you for the revised draft. We appreciate the streamlining, but the agreement still leaves the Buyer carrying too much closing and post-closing risk.

At this stage, our client is prepared to keep the deal moving, but we do need a few targeted protections reflected in the document: a workable purchase price adjustment or, at minimum, a limited escrow/holdback; a buyer-side closing condition with full closing deliverables and a bring-down of the Seller’s representations at Closing; and a more conventional indemnity structure with agreed survival, cap, basket, and fraud/fundamental rep carve-outs.

If you can circulate a revised draft on those points, we should be able to progress efficiently.
